components.explanation: Effect A, SlashSparks: effects/slash_sparks.tscn, a Node2D root with two GPUParticles2D emitters, Flash (1 particle, 0.12 s) and Sparks (28 streaks, 0.45 s, one shot, explosiveness 1.0), each with a ParticleProcessMaterial and a GradientTexture2D with a dark rim; local_coords off. previews/slash_sparks_preview.gd/.tscn is the fixture the strips were captured from: Level 1 frozen, a still Rudy, seeded bursts on frames 10 and 20.

Effect B, RunDust: effects/run_dust.tscn, one GPUParticles2D (40 puffs, 0.5 s, a steady stream) with a box emission shape, velocity 80–160 px/s up, and damping 120–180 px/s², the feature Effect A does not use; local_coords off makes the trail, trail_enabled stays false because the Compatibility renderer does not draw it. previews/run_dust_preview.gd/.tscn is the strip fixture: the emitter and Rudy's sprite move at 560 px/s from frame 10 and stop at frame 40.

effects/effects_driver.gd, after Rudy in app/main.tscn: each physics tick it starts a new SlashSparks burst on the true → false edge of Rudy's SwordHitbox/Shape.disabled, placed on the hitbox and mirrored with facing, and switches RunDust's emitting with the run condition (mode PLAY, on the floor, |velocity.x| > 1, visible in the tree), keeping it at his soles. content/rudy/rudy.gd owns the event and the condition and is unchanged; project.godot names GL Compatibility.

shaders/particles_generated.gdshader: the particles shader Godot 4.7.2's editor generated from a copy of Sparks' ParticleProcessMaterial, saved by shuai-z; nothing uses it. Line 139 picks each speed between the velocity uniforms, line 311 starts the force from gravity.

The new headless tests: tests/test_slash_sparks_config.gd (108 checks) and tests/test_run_dust_config.gd (61) compare every setting with the brief and scan for Godot 3 names; tests/test_slash_sparks_state.gd/.tscn and tests/test_run_dust_state.gd/.tscn (14 each) run the real Main through input actions; tests/cost_effects.gd measures the headless CPU price against an empty-scene control.
app/vsync_debug.gd, the VsyncDebug node last in Main: F9 turns vsync off and on again, for the FPS fallback when the Visual Profiler reports no GPU time.
